title: Izwi Rechokwadi Renguva Dzekare
intro: Mune mweya muKorani une nyaya inotaurwa mundima shoma chete, asi hunhu hwavo hwakanaka hunopenya zvakajeka. Achirumbidzwa neWemasimbaose nekuda kwehunhu hwake hwakanaka, muranda wekare uyu weNyasha ane nzvimbo mumapeji ezvakazarurwa. Basa rako nderekuziva munhu uyu anoshamisa. Ungafungidzira here kuti ndivanaani?
clues: Ndiri muporofita waAllah akararama pakati pezvizvarwa zvekutanga zvevanhu.
Allah akanditaura mubhuku rake pamwe chete nevamwe vaprofita, vose vakarumbidzwa nekuda kwehunhu hwakanaka hwakafanana.
Allah vakandisimudzira panzvimbo yakakwirira iyo vamwe vashoma vakasvika.
Zita rangu rinotaurwa muSurah Al-Anbiya, pamwe chete nevamwe vaprofita vaviri vakarumbidzwa nekuda kwemwoyo murefu wavo.
Ndini Idris, muporofita wechokwadi uye akakwidziridzwa.
